ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A specialized village refers to a rural village in which most farm households commercially engage in one type of, and related, production or service activity, and the total economic volume of this activity constitutes the main body of the village’s total economic volume. Below is a map of the terrain of Henan Province and the distribution of four types of specialized villages. Complete the following questions. <image1> Among the four agricultural products in the figure, which one's planting is most obviously restricted by terrain and climate factors?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the legend on the left side of the figure shows that black circles represent apple planting, and black triangles represent flower planting; the legend on the right side shows that boxes represent vegetable planting, and stars represent tea planting. On the map, the distribution ranges of specialized villages for apples, flowers, and vegetables are relatively wide, with points in plains, hills, or many places; tea planting points are fewer in number, mainly concentrated in the southern and southeastern parts of Henan Province near mountainous areas and areas of lower latitude, and are more clearly connected with the mountainous and hilly environment where contour lines are relatively dense. Then reason: if a crop is only concentrated in specific southern warm and humid mountainous areas, unlike other crops that are widely distributed, it shows that it has higher requirements for terrain and climate conditions. Tea is the most concentrated and most southerly in the figure, and is most obviously restricted by mountainous terrain and warm and humid climate. Therefore the answer is tea.
